body.description: Pixel-art diorama: an intimate lived-in refuge at a dungeon entrance. Broad connected color clusters, compact heroic silhouettes, matte planes, crisp stepped edges, quiet shadow masses and selective details. 8-12 varied mercenaries talk in pairs, share bowls and mend equipment, amid bedrolls, patched cloth and sacks. Exactly ONE small mage stands apart, STRICTLY BACK TO CAMERA, entirely in deep architectural shadow. Opaque black hood and cloak conceal face, skin, hands, hair, age and gender; no rim light. Nobody notices, looks toward or reacts to the mage. Social warmth belongs to others; the mage is excluded from their connections. No war, army, battlefield, ruined city, monsters, epic scale, magic glow, grain, dithering, text, icons or HUD. PLACE: A tiny abandoned underground bathhouse reused as shelter. Empty shallow basin, low divider walls, folded blankets, a cracked water spout and warm communal repair nook. A dry drainage passage leads into the dungeon. COMPOSITION: Side view across the sunken basin; people on low far benches, a foreground pillar hides the mage niche. COLOR SCRIPT: storm blue, muted mauve, brown-black timber, low straw-yellow lamps. Restrained saturation, a legible dark mage silhouette. One complete scene with a quiet dark surrounding field, no decorative frame.
